summary_en: This Phase 1a/1b study tests GTB-5550, a B7-H3-targeted natural killer cell engager called a TriSpecific Killer Engager, in select advanced solid tumors that failed prior therapy. GTB-5550 is given as a subcutaneous injection in the abdomen at one of six assigned doses, once a day on Days 1-5 and Days 8-12 of each 28-day cycle, followed by 2 weeks without treatment, and from Cycle 2 on it is given three times per week in weeks 1 and 2 (not on 3 consecutive days). The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1a/1b evalúa GTB-5550, un motor de células asesinas naturales dirigido a B7-H3 llamado TriSpecific Killer Engager, en tumores sólidos avanzados seleccionados que fracasaron con tratamientos previos. GTB-5550 se administra como inyección subcutánea en el abdomen, en una de seis dosis asignadas, una vez al día los días 1 al 5 y 8 al 12 de cada ciclo de 28 días, seguida de 2 semanas sin tratamiento; a partir del ciclo 2 se administra tres veces por semana en las semanas 1 y 2 (no en 3 días consecutivos). El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; este es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Age 18 or older with advanced or metastatic cancer confirmed by tissue or cytology.
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1; bone-only mCRPC is exempt.
Adequate blood, kidney, liver, heart and lung function within study limits.
Phase 1a only: agrees to stay within a 60-minute drive of the study center through Cycle 1 Day 15.
not_for: Anticancer treatment, surgery or radiotherapy within 14 days before the first dose; radioligand therapy needs longer washout.
Prior organ or allogeneic transplant, with one stated exception.
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy within 4 months after the last dose.
QTc above 480 msec at screening or a family history of long QT syndrome.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment within the past year.
